items.briefing:
Security teams should be aware of several active threats circulating today. A vulnerability in Zimbra email software is being actively exploited, and attackers are moving faster than ever — organisations need to apply patches quickly once they're released. Separately, a new malware technique called WordlistLoader hides malicious code inside what looks like ordinary text files, while SynkLoader is a versatile attack tool potentially linked to ransomware. The ToxicPanda banking trojan has also evolved and is now targeting businesses, not just personal devices.

If your organisation uses Zimbra for email, check with your IT provider today to confirm it's fully up to date.

featured.title: Exploited Zimbra Flaw Highlights Shrinking Window to Patch
